@@name@@Jack in the Box@@icon@@Jack in the Box.png@@icon2@@{{{icon2}}}@@icon3@@{{{icon3}}}@@icon4@@{{{icon4}}}@@description@@'''Active:''' '''Shaco''' summons a ''box'' at the target location that becomes [[File:Noxious Trap.png|20px|link=Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|An icon representing the keyword Stealthed trap]] [[:Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|stealthed]] after arming over 2 seconds, lasting for up to 40 (+ 10% AP) seconds. The ''box'' is [[File:Cosmic Radiance.png|20px|link=Invulnerability|An icon representing the keyword Invulnerability]] [[:Invulnerability|invulnerable]] and [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] to enemies while stealthed.@@description2@@The ''box'' will spring out upon enemy contact, [[File:Flee icon.png|20px|link=Flee|An icon representing the keyword Flee]] [[:Flee|fearing]] nearby enemies for a duration, modified to 2.2 seconds against non-champions, and [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooting]] them for a duration, modified to a 1 second root against non-champions. After a 0.15-second delay of the ''box's'' activation, enemies hit also have their [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] movement speed reduced. Enemy champions have their movement speed set to a static 100, while non-champions are set to a static 60. The movement speed reduction lasts for the same duration as the fear plus 0.3 seconds.@@description3@@Once sprung, the ''box'' will remain for 5 seconds, during which it will automatically fire at nearby [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] enemies every 0.5 seconds, dealing magic damage with each attack. If the ''box'' attacks only one target, it deals increased damage. ''Boxes'' deal '''bonus''' magic damage to [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] and 50% reduced damage to [[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|structures]].@@description4@@''See [[Shaco#Pets|Pets]] for more details about boxes.''@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@

Effects that reveal [[File:Noxious Trap.png|20px|link=Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|An icon representing the keyword Stealthed trap]] [[:Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|stealthed traps]] will render the box targetable and vulnerable while it can be seen.@@
